# Move each file to the new structure: <file_name>/<date>.<extension>
base_dir = '~/documents/work/meetings_data/'
for src in files:
    # src is like /home/sierra/documents/work/meetings_data/2023-apr-04__slides.ppt
    # Extract the filename part after the last '/'
    filename = src.rsplit('/', 1)[-1]
    # Split on '__' to get date and rest
    date_part, rest = filename.split('__', 1)
    # rest is like slides.ppt or video_recording.mp4
    # Split on last '.' to get file_name and extension
    file_name, ext = rest.rsplit('.', 1)
    # Construct destination path
    dest = base_dir + file_name + '/' + date_part + '.' + ext
    print(apis.file_system.move_file(source_file_path=src, destination_file_path=dest, access_token=fs_token))
